Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the evidence and concluded that Nintendo’s limit was 10 games per year by doubling the five-per-publisher cap to account for subsidiary labels (e.g., Ultra Games). This conflated an “effective workaround” with the actual policy. The cited source states a cap of five games per year (per publisher) for NES; the question asks for Nintendo’s limit, not an effective total via circumvention.
